Targeted: `--test watchdog`, local fallback — the checkout had no git remote,
so the wrapper ran it cgroup-limited.

```verified:
cargo test --test watchdog
```

```cargo-output
[cargo-remote] no git remote
[cargo-remote] falling back to local (cgroup-limited run)
     Running tests/watchdog.rs
test result: ok. 6 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored
```
